title: SPRINGFIELD SYMPHONY: An American Hymn
seo_title: Springfield Symphony: An American Hymn, Feb 13, 2027
description: The Springfield Symphony Orchestra presents An American Hymn, a concert of religious works by American composers, including Bernstein's Chichester Psalms with the Combined University Choirs, Copland's Appalachian Spring, and Jessie Montgomery's Starburst. It takes place Saturday, February 13, 2027 at 7:30 PM at Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO. Tickets are sold only through HammonsHall.com and MissouriStateTix.com.
venue: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts
